name: Wild Sunflower
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this flower, but it affects the finished diameter and petal firmness.

steps.label: Rnd 1
steps.text: With brown yarn, work 6 sc in MR. Pull the ring closed.

steps.label: Rnd 3
steps.text: [Sc in next st, inc in next st] rep 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 4
steps.text: [Sc in next 2 st, inc in next st] rep 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 5
steps.text: [Puff in next st, sc in next st] rep 12 times. Fasten off brown yarn.

steps.label: Rnd 6
steps.text: Join yellow yarn in the FLO of any rnd 5 st. Rep 12 times: sl st in next st, ch 9, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 5 ch, sl st in next st. Fasten off yellow yarn.

steps.label: Rnd 7
steps.text: Join yellow yarn in the BLO of any rnd 5 st. Rep 12 times: sl st in next st, ch 11, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 7 ch, sl st in next st. Fasten off, leaving a 15 cm tail.

steps.label: Rnd 1
steps.text: With green yarn, work 6 sc in MR. Pull the ring closed.

steps.label: Rnd 3
steps.text: [Sc in next st, inc in next st] rep 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 4
steps.text: [Sc in next 2 st, inc in next st] rep 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 5
steps.text: Rep 12 times: sl st in next st, ch 7, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 3 ch, sl st in next st. Fasten off, leaving a 30 cm tail for assembly.

assembly: Centre the calyx against the reverse of the flower front, with the green calyx leaves pointing outward between the yellow outer petals.

Using the long green tail, sew 12 evenly spaced whip stitches through the outer edge of green rnd 4 and the back of brown rnd 5. Keep the stitches clear of the yellow petals and secure the tail on the reverse.
finishing: Fasten off all active yarn securely, leaving the specified sewing tails before cutting the yarn.
Weave in the remaining yarn tails on the reverse side, taking care not to pull the centre out of shape.
Gently spread and curve the yellow petals outward so both petal rounds are visible.
Lightly steam-block the flower if needed, keeping the iron above the yarn rather than touching it.
notes: puff: (yo, insert hook in indicated st, yo, pull up a loop) 3 times, yo, pull through all 7 loops.
The inner petals are worked in the FLO and the longer outer petals in the BLO of brown rnd 5, creating two distinct petal layers.
